parsed.rationale: After the last release, the analytics dashboard now takes 30–45 seconds to load instead of under 5 seconds, impacting daily planning for 25 users, but it eventually loads. This indicates a performance/latency regression best handled by engineering.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. We understand that after the most recent release, the analytics dashboard now takes about 30–45 seconds to load (previously under 5 seconds) for your operations team, which is slowing daily planning for 25 users. 

We’ve passed this to our Engineering team to investigate the post-release performance regression. In the meantime, could you share a couple of details so we can narrow it down quickly:
1) Approximate timestamp/date of the release you’re referring to (and your time zone).
2) Are the slow loads happening for all 25 users or only some users/locations?
3) Do you notice the slowdown on every dashboard page/module, or only specific analytics views?

If you have any recent browser console/network logs or a HAR capture from a slow load attempt, that would also be helpful. Thanks again—while we look into this, we’ll keep you updated on what we find.

grounded_facts: The analytics dashboard takes 30 to 45 seconds to load since the last release.

User-facing production impact on dashboard responsiveness, though the dashboard eventually loads.
